name: How does contractor hookup coordination differ from standard delivery installation?

mainEntity.name: How does contractor hookup coordination differ from standard delivery installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery teams typically only plug in basic cords or attach standard braided hoses to pre-existing, accessible shutoff valves. They generally do not alter cabinetry, run new copper or PEX water lines, extend gas piping, or install dedicated electrical circuits. A remodeling contractor coordinates licensed trades to run new infrastructure and handles custom trim, panel installations, and cabinet modifications required for built-in wall ovens, cooktops, and integrated dishwashers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Delivery crews only connect to existing, accessible valves and plugs. A contractor coordinates licensed trades to run new lines and adjusts cabinetry for built-in appliances.
